subject.title: Feature: Surface cron job name / session label in /status and statusline

question: Should OpenClaw make sanitized session `label`/`displayName` primary in CLI/TUI status surfaces now, and should maintainers adopt the existing fork PR or request a narrow replacement?
rationale: The remaining behavior is clear, but the issue carries product/no-new-fix-pr signals and an open fork PR claims the same work; maintainers need to choose the display policy and branch path before automation opens another fix.

options.title: Adopt or replace with a narrow sanitized fix
options.body: Make friendly labels primary only in the human CLI/TUI surfaces, preserve raw keys as fallback/detail, and keep the JSON attribution expansion separate.

options.title: Fold into broader attribution work
options.body: Defer this display change until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85688 defines stable status/usage attribution fields.

options.title: Keep raw keys primary
options.body: Close or deprioritize the request if maintainers decide status surfaces should favor stable selectors over friendly labels.

recommendation.title: Adopt or replace with a narrow sanitized fix
recommendation.body: Make friendly labels primary only in the human CLI/TUI surfaces, preserve raw keys as fallback/detail, and keep the JSON attribution expansion separate.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this owner to both status helper consolidation and session label fallback behavior, and the decision spans those two boundaries.
